Do edits need to be reviewed again?

No. Once your listing is approved, edits go live straight away after automatic checks: Stoatmod's AI scans the new text, and a new invite must open the same server. If a check flags something, the edit waits for a person while your current listing stays live.
Can I get a custom link like modstoat.site/myserver?

Yes. Approved listings can claim a free custom link in the Discovery tab of the dashboard. It forwards straight to your Stoat invite, so it is easy to share. Brand names are kept for verified servers.
How do I get the verified tick?

Approved listings can apply for verification from the dashboard. The tick is for official Stoatmod servers, verified organisations, communities of high standing and impactful communities. See the verified servers page for details.
Can I see how many people visit my listing?

Yes. The Discovery tab shows daily profile views, join clicks and custom link visits for the last 30 days, and where visitors came from. Stoatmod only keeps daily totals: no IP addresses, cookies or visitor profiles.
Can I add my own logo and format the description?
Yes. Upload a logo and banner (scanned before they appear), and use simple formatting in the server information: headings, bold, italics, lists and links.
